nhom_radio_Automatic_Manual._ket_luan_quan_trong: Nhom radio cua DNS (IPv4), DNS (IPv6) va VLAN autoDetection dung Y HET mot cau truc -- da do va so sanh truc tiep: class nhom giong nhau tuyet doi.
nhom_radio_Automatic_Manual._he_qua: Ban chup advanced__wan.html DA CO san nhom nay (cua DNS IPv6) -> nhan ban duoc cho DNS IPv4 va cho VLAN ma khong phai bia gi.

nhom_ipVersion_khac._ghi_chu: bay NGANG (row), da co san trong ban chup

xac_nhan_cay_an_hien_bang_THUC_NGHIEM: ipv4 protocol = pppoe -> hien PPP Username + PPP Password, AN 3 o Static (ipAddress/mask/gateway). Da do: con_o_static=false.
ipv4 protocol != static -> nhom radio DNS cua IPv4 HIEN RA (luc protocol=static thi bi an). Da do.
ipv6 protocol = static -> hien IPv6 WAN Address + IPv6 Gateway Address + Custom Delegated IPv6-Prefix. Da do du 3 o.
bat cong tac VLAN (luc ipv4 protocol=static) -> o VLAN ID hien ra NGAY, nhom radio autoDetection KHONG hien (dung nhu ma goc: radio chi hien khi protocol==='dhcp')
doi tiep ipv4 protocol sang dhcp -> nhom radio VLAN autoDetection hien ra (dem duoc 3 nhom radio: ipVersion, DNS, VLAN)
tuy chon 'Static' cua IPv6 KHONG bi vo hieu hoa luc ipv4 protocol=static (dung ma goc: chi vo hieu khi ipv4 protocol==='pppoe')
_con_thieu: Chua do duoc trang thai tuy chon 'Static' cua IPv6 BI VO HIEU HOA (can dat ipv4=pppoe VA ipv6 dang mo menu cung luc) -- ma goc noi ro dieu kien, nhung chua co anh chup lop Mui-disabled cua the <li>.
Chua do tab 'Backup' vi thiet bi khong co ban ghi interfaces/configurations nao mang usage='Backup'.
